verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI Atlas feature lets users 'ask it anything about your sales tax' and get grounded answers, showing a natural-language query interface, and headless-tax mentions handing tax operations to agents. However, evidence only shows NL-based Q&A/insight retrieval, not full operational control (e.g., creating transactions, managing filings) via natural language commands. missing for 10: evidence of NL commands executing actions (not just queries), documentation of command syntax/scope, independent verification of AI Atlas performance.
